pages.text: Buddha Fire Lotus is an immortal active Wood-Fire spell. Hold the cast key to gather cyan and white flames in both hands, compress them, then form a lotus. Reaching 100% costs about 10000 qi.

Release to send the lotus toward the locked target. On impact, it blooms into a giant lotus with fire, shockwaves, lightning, and multi-hit damage. Base damage starts at 1000 and uses normal spell scaling, without direct true-health damage.
